source.doc: Itron CENTRON C1S product sheet 100188SP-06 (11/11), drawing letters A-G

entries.licence_note: manufacturer datasheet; numbers cited as facts, PDF not redistributed
entries.notes: Polycarbonate column. Cover OD is drawing letter A, printed 6.29 in (letter F prints the same 6.29 in). Base OD is letter B, printed 6.95 in (letter G prints the same 6.95 in). Overall depth is letter E, printed 4.53 in, from the back of the base to the front of the cover. Letter C is printed 2.7 in and runs from the flange's front face to the cover front. That is the kind of length the brief calls rim_offset_m, but it is left null here. Letter D is printed 3.16 in (side profile) and is not stored. Glass cover is itron-centron-c1s-glass. The sheet lists ANSI C12.10-1997 as a met standard and does not print a separate ANSI base diameter. The C1SRC dual-protocol module sheet repeats this same column, so that module is not a second cover.

source.doc: Aclara Residential Electrical Metering brochure, file mark E-0217, pages 7-8 headed I-210+c

entries.licence_note: manufacturer brochure rehosted at the cited URL; numbers cited as facts, PDF not redistributed
entries.notes: Depth 5.25 in MAX (stored 0.1334 m; 5.25 in x 0.0254 = 0.13335 m, half-up) is taken from brochure pages 7-8. Both of those pages are headed I-210+c, not I-210+. The number stays on this row because that is the A9 seed attribution for the I-210+ depth, and it is the same depth the I-210+c FlexNet row cites. The drawing also prints 6.94 in MAX on the horizontal diameter of the body. That callout is not labeled cover or base flange, so cover_od_m and base_od_m stay null. Cover options on the same sheet are polycarbonate with a molded sunshield. No cover diameter is printed.

It prints Low Profile Poly (5.5 in) in the cover-options table and does not say whether 5.5 in is diameter or height. 5.5 in is 0.1397 m, below the 0.150 m cover floor, so it is not stored as cover_od_m. source.doc: Itron OpenWay Riva CENTRON meter NAM, 101441SP-06 (02/18), page 4, letter G across the cover

entries.licence_note: manufacturer document; numbers cited as facts, PDF not redistributed
entries.notes: Page 4 drawing, same side-view type as the CENTRON C1S sheet. Letter G is printed 6.30 in (16 cm) and spans the cover at its widest, next to the flange (stored 0.1600 m). Letter A is printed 6.95 in and is the base flange (stored as base_od_m). Letter B is printed 5.27 in and is the overall depth (stored as depth_overall_m). Letter F is printed 5.68 in across the cover front face and is not stored as the cover OD. Letter C is printed 4.37 in. Letters D and E are printed 3.97 in and 3.47 in. Those three are not stored. Class 200 on 1S, 2S and 12S/25S, and class 320 on 2S.
